# Devero & AS Cambiago Sold Out: Brianteo Option | MSC 2026

Devero Hotel and AS Hotel Cambiago are sold out for MSC 2026. Discover Brianteo, our suggested third hotel, and check availability through the hotel guide.

Canonical: https://milanosensualcongress.com/news/devero-hotel-sold-out-as-cambiago-2026

### Both congress hotels are sold out

**Devero Hotel, the main hotel for Milano Sensual Congress, has been sold out for the 2026 edition since August.** Thank you to everyone who has already booked their stay for our Bachata weekend on **20–22 November 2026**.

**AS Hotel Cambiago, our second congress hotel, is now also sold out.** If you still need a room, check Brianteo Hotel Residence and Restaurant on Booking.com through our hotel page.

### Brianteo: a third hotel option

Brianteo Hotel Residence and Restaurant is a four-star hotel in Burago di Molgora. It is a suggested alternative for the 2026 weekend. Select your dates and check the current room availability, price and conditions on Booking.com.

See the [MSC hotel page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/hotel) for the Brianteo booking link, location and travel guidance, or follow our [hotel booking guide](https://milanosensualcongress.com/BookHotel#brianteo).

### The congress stays at Devero

All congress workshops, shows and parties will take place at **Devero Hotel**. Guests staying at another hotel will join the event there. Arrange your travel to Devero and your return after the parties before you book.

Travelling to Milan from abroad? Check our [transfer information](https://milanosensualcongress.com/transfer) as you plan your journey. For help with your stay, visit the [MSC contact page](https://milanosensualcongress.com/contact).
